plugins.prepareCmd: cd comixed-webui && pnpm pkg set "version=${nextRelease.version}" && cd .. && case "$RELEASE_BRANCH" in release/*) mvn versions:set-property -Dproperty=revision -DnewVersion=${nextRelease.version} -DgenerateBackupPoms=false ;; *) echo "Leaving Maven development version unchanged on $RELEASE_BRANCH" ;; esac
